defects.title: Dedicated end-user LLM browser workflow is missing
evidence: RepoPrompt path search under `web/src/routes` for `llm` returned no matches on 2026-05-04.
defects.suspected_root_cause: The approved user-facing LLM workflow was never implemented in the web route surface; current browser support stops at shared relay-backed state consumption.
defects.recommended_fix: Implement a dedicated browser LLM workflow that supports route creation, release registration, deploy initiation, approval visibility, and relay-backed route/activity views using signer-first Nostr requests.

defects.title: Missing reactor-level signer-first contract tests for LLM request/result flows
evidence: `go test ./internal/controlplane ./internal/service` passed on 2026-05-04, exercising the new signer-first reactor and rejection-repair coverage.
defects.suspected_root_cause: Coverage had stopped at helper tests and MCP request-shaping tests until the signer-first reactor and rejection-repair cases were added.
defects.recommended_fix: No further fix required for this defect; keep the new reactor-level and registry regression tests passing as part of the suite.

defects.title: Missing provisioning coordinator verification for async LLM deployment lifecycle
evidence: RepoPrompt path search for `internal/service/llm_provisioning_coordinator_test.go` returned no matches on 2026-05-04.
defects.suspected_root_cause: The async provisioning path was implemented without a dedicated fake-backed coordinator test harness.
defects.recommended_fix: Add coordinator tests that exercise `ProcessOnce` success and failure paths with capture responders and fake placement/provisioner/gateway dependencies.

defects.title: Missing explicit spoofed-author LLM browser-store negative test
evidence: RepoPrompt content search for explicit spoofed LLM route/state/activity coverage returned no matches on 2026-05-04.
`web/tests/unit/controlplane-store.test.js` now includes `ignores spoofed non-Bahia LLM route, state, and activity events`.
`cd /Users/bizarro/Documents/Projects/bahia/web && npm test -- --run tests/unit/controlplane-store.test.js` passed with 9 tests on 2026-05-04.
defects.suspected_root_cause: The browser store suite verifies a generic spoofed service-registry event but does not include an LLM-specific negative case.
defects.recommended_fix: Extend `web/tests/unit/controlplane-store.test.js` with spoofed non-Bahia LLM route, route-state, and deployment activity events and assert they are ignored.

defects.title: Missing requester-side relay-acceptance verification for signer-first LLM route/release requests
evidence: internal/controlplane/reactor_llm_requests_test.go injects signed request events directly into `handleLLMRouteCreate` and `handleLLMReleaseRegister`.
No route-create or release-register requester/publisher test exists analogous to `internal/controlplane/llm_command_publisher_test.go` for deploy.
pstf/features/LLM_ROUTE_RELEASE_DEPLOYMENT/acceptance_criteria.json requires at least one accepted relay publish for AC-002 and AC-003.
defects.suspected_root_cause: The Bahia-side reactor contract was tested, but requester-side publish acceptance for 5971/5972 is either unimplemented in this repository or untested.
defects.recommended_fix: Add requester/publisher-path coverage for route-create and release-register acceptance semantics, or explicitly narrow the verification claim if that responsibility lives outside this repository.
